title: One Table and Thirty Years
subtitle: 社区社会 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 社区社会（社会服务与人际沟通·社区与社会参与）
meta: 主题语境：社区社会（社会服务与人际沟通·社区与社会参与）　|　核心词汇：committee　|　正文 334 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 committee 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1958 my grandmother ① sat on a committee that decided nothing for eleven years, and she said the sitting was the whole of the service. The ② committee, meaning the table and not the members, met in a cold room and stayed there; committee, she said, is the only thing in a village that is judged by how little it decides.

Every ③ committee in that parish had the same minute book, and the ④ committee at the end, meaning the one she kept for the roof and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Committee, my mother said, is nine parts minutes and one part somebody willing to sit; my grandmother said the minutes are the part that fills the book.

My father meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the committee was the whole of the argument, meaning the people and not the table. The ⑥ committee, meaning the people and not any of that, is the only thing in an argument that everybody blames and nobody names; committee, he said, is either something you sit on or the only word that means both a table and the people at it. She said the people are the part they remember.

By 1966 the ⑦ committee had become a line in the accounts, and the line had become an argument about the roof. The ⑧ committee of the whole thing, my grandmother wrote in March, was one table and thirty years of minutes; committee, she said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to keep a book. He said the book was never mentioned.

The ⑨ committee I remember is the one at the end, which met in 1972 and is still described as the coldest in the county. A ⑩ committee, my mother said in 1974, is the only thing that improves by being thanked; every committee, she said, is a group of people that has agreed to look like a table. She said the people were the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 委员会（指那张会议桌本身，与那些成员相对）
C. 固定搭配：sit on a committee 担任委员会成员
D. n. 委员会（指那个教区里每一个）
E. n. 委员会（指末尾那一个）
F. n. 委员会（指账目里提到的那一个）
G. n. 那群人（抽象：委员会里的人）
H. n. 议事机制；集体决策（抽象总称）

items.q: sat on a committee that decided nothing
The committee, meaning the table and not the members
the committee was the whole of the argument
the committee had become a line in the accounts
The committee of the whole thing
A committee, my mother said in 1974

answers.why: sit on a committee 意为“担任委员会成员”，1958 年祖母在一个十一年没做成任何决定的委员会里任职。
committee 意为“委员会”，指那张会议桌本身而不是那些成员，它在一间冷屋子里开会。
committee 指那个教区里每一个委员会，每一个都用同一本会议记录簿。
committee 指末尾那一个（她留给屋顶修缮的那一个），是唯一有人谢过两次的。
committee 意为“那群人”，父亲说委员会就是那场争论的全部，指的是坐在桌边的那些人。
committee 为抽象用法，指委员会里的人而不是那张桌子，是争论里人人都责怪、却无人点名的东西。
committee 意为“委员会”，指账目里提到的那一个，到 1966 年这个委员会成了账目里的一行。
committee 意为“议事机制、集体决策”，祖母三月写道，整件事的议事机制是一张桌子三十年的记录。
committee 意为“委员会”，我记得的是末尾那一个，1972 年开的会，至今仍被说成全县最冷的。
committee 为抽象总称，母亲说一个委员会是唯一会因为被致谢而变好的东西。
